laterStages: Supplement stages 4-7 are deferred and separately authorized.

tasks.title: Reconcile existing source, evidence and Git history
deliverables: Census all legacy components as reuse/adapt/revalidate/defer, with paths and current digests; separate historical approvals from current bytes and integration proof.
Record actual Git HEAD/dirty state without committing, resetting or stashing; plan a reviewed synthetic/project baseline.
Preserve legacy graph/state/receipts; publish metadata drift and real runtime/model gaps instead of rewriting old approvals.
acceptance: 18 review/14 blocked records are reconciled against current source without inventing current approvals; snapshots and historical handoffs remain intact.
Git base is explicitly absent until a real commit exists; no product changes, process startup or legacy coordinator writes occur in the reconciliation scope.
verification: Read-only Git status/HEAD and exact file/evidence hash comparison; no product test execution is required to claim this inventory.
Independent reviewer checks at least one previously approved, one checked/currently stale and one runner-blocked component and validates the preservation manifest.

tasks.title: Approve the Open Box seams and kitchen runtime contract
deliverables: Review separate BoxVersion/Attempt/API design and open_trusted versus restricted profile boundaries with Product/Assurance leads.
Inspect actual Cursor pstack/model/tool capability read-only and document native/fallback mapping, station topology and bounded resource policy.
Prepare one-unit orchestration pilot for the first implementation wave; installation/global configuration and actual dispatch remain separately approved actions.

Inventory exact shared integration paths (tooling/suite registration, service/app bootstrap, DB schema and auth wiring) and include each required write/worker/revalidation explicitly in the next approved brief.
acceptance: Domain/profile/API proposal is concrete and independently reviewed; no existing hostile/private gate is weakened.
Native plugin installation, mode activation and dispatch are recorded as observed or unverified, never inferred from Markdown; first coding wave cannot fan out before its approved pilot succeeds.
verification: Read source paths, installed plugin metadata only where accessible, actual tool schemas and host capability records; never read credential stores.
Independent architecture/profile review challenges cloud defaults, gate authority, model availability, four-slot nesting and persisted resume behavior.
Inspect actual installed native orch runtime/store capability separately from skills/Task; absence means incomplete native capability and an explicitly labeled adaptation.

tasks.title: Implement the versioned Open Box aggregate and transitions
deliverables: Typed BoxVersion, Attempt, EvaluationReceipt, Assignment, ReviewDecision and MergeRecord with immutable version hashes and explicit open_trusted profile.
Forward migrations and idempotent optimistic state transitions; server-side author/executor/reviewer/merge-owner permissions and scoped attempt identity.
Register meaningful future test:box-contracts and test:box-auth commands through a coordinator tooling lease.
acceptance: Single-unit, UI/API and UI/API/policy Boxes validate; mandatory reward/disclosure/dedicated-KVM fields do not contaminate the Open Box schema.
Draft/approval/edit invalidation, wrong identity, cross-repo/attempt IDs, stale updates and illegal transitions are rejected server-side.
Current profile remains separate from legacy restricted enums/guards; no new private-to-external serializer is introduced.
Use this first coding unit as the approved lead/worker/verifier orchestration pilot. Verify its durable receipt and actual adapter before any parallel implementation fan-out.
verification: Required new commands node scripts/pnpm.mjs test:box-contracts and test:box-auth plus existing check/build; missing scripts are unavailable until implemented.
Real fresh migration and API transaction checks against identified synthetic DB; independent literal expected outcomes.

tasks.title: Create real Git-backed attempts and actual patch capture
deliverables: Registered reviewed repository roots, real synthetic Git baseline, isolated branch/worktree attempts and actual patch/hash capture.
Fixed argument-array Git adapter with portable path checks, dirty-root preservation and one-writer leases.
Bind actual base/candidate Git IDs and diff bytes to Box version/provenance; no merge is implemented by a digest placeholder.

Reject traversal/link/unsafe roots and forbidden edits; root user edits are neither stashed nor lost; fake base SHA is impossible.
Consume the verified first-unit orchestration pilot receipt before broader Git/worktree fan-out; adapter/approval identities still match.
verification: Required new test:box-git uses real owned temporary Git repositories and worktrees, not mocked Git success.
Verify clean round trip, dirty-root refusal, cancellation/cleanup scope, wrong-base patch and exact candidate/diff bindings.

tasks.title: Persist grounded intent conversations
deliverables: Persistent conversation turns, repo/evidence references, facts/assumptions/unknowns and consequential internal decisions.
Goal-first UX and typed private provider adapter using relevant pinned context; demo/local live modes remain separate.
Connect intent revisions to Box drafts without running model tools, approving outcomes or exposing private model chat to executors.

Required unresolved decisions block readiness; invented facts are labeled; malformed/model timeout responses cannot approve a Box.
Demo protocol checks are not recorded as live model or good requirement quality.
verification: Required new test:box-intents runs persistence/provider/failure tests and a synthetic conversation API journey.
Independent intent reviewer checks unknowns, stale evidence, wrong roles, prompt injection and no model-authorized execution.

tasks.title: Approve expected behavior before implementation
deliverables: Reviewable versioned behavior artifact with examples, before/after flow, API/state/error cases and exclusions.
Exact human approval, edit invalidation and requirement-to-evaluator links; data-only previews with safe rendering.
Coherent UI/API feature and independent response-policy goal with immutable desired outcome.
acceptance: Requester can understand and approve behavior before code exists; unresolved choices and stale approval are visible and enforced.
A polished mockup or generated test cannot substitute for approval or acceptance; candidates never run in control-plane origin.
Alternative implementations may satisfy the same behavior; private unpublished assumptions remain Box defects.
verification: Required new test:box-behavior plus actual synthetic browser approval/stale-edit/keyboard/error journeys.
Independent reviewer challenges conflicting examples, missing API error states and unsafe rendered evidence.

deliverables: Approved local Dev Container/Docker workspace recipe with pinned tools/images, attempt mounts and bounded resources.

Keep Open Box IDs/profile separate from unavailable dedicated hostile-runner services.

Candidate/repository code executes only in declared workspace, not the host; no arbitrary model shell strings or privileged fallback.
Sparse checkout is optional context reduction and no secrecy claim; restricted_private/hostile_external cannot route here.
verification: Required new test:box-workspaces --real on approved existing Docker environment; unit mocks remain separate.
Verify actual limits, mount/network policy, image/digest drift, cancelled jobs and scoped cleanup without touching unrelated data.

tasks.title: Evaluate attempts independently and record exact evidence
deliverables: Pinned evaluator recipe/command graph, solver-visible checks and independent acceptance obligations with bounded receipts.
Unit/interface/end-to-end/preservation aggregation for UI/API and data-only policy fixtures.
Exact candidate/environment/evaluator bindings; contract/integration/Box-defect/infrastructure/unverified outcomes.
acceptance: A real good attempt passes; local-unit-pass/API-mismatch fails the whole Box; missing published obligation is Box defect.
Forged pass stdout, stale receipt, changed evaluator, timeout and missing independent checks cannot pass.
No legacy runner permit/signature guards are bypassed; trusted profile results do not clear restricted gates.
verification: Required new test:box-evaluation --real exercises actual workspace artifacts and independently authored expectations.
Use alternative satisfying patch, wrong output, mismatch, missing-context, cancelled/unavailable and evaluator-drift cases.

Shared human/agent capability checks, scoped agent identities and idempotent operation/event records.
Readiness/transition contract that makes absent profile/evaluator/approval explicit.

Cross-repo/attempt/resource access fails server-side; executor cannot review/merge itself; no duplicate authoritative submissions.
Private and external legacy data remain isolated and no new general internal serializer leaks context.
verification: Required new test:box-api runs actual synthetic authenticated API transaction and stale/concurrent/idempotency checks.
Independent authorization audit and interface/version tests against literal behaviors.

tasks.title: Make Box Web the control surface

verification: Required new test:box-web drives real browser/API flows on approved synthetic service instances.
Independent keyboard/responsive/error/status/reload checks with screenshots; no code-generated screenshot substitutes.

Independent inspect/open/edit/check/diff cycle, reconnect/error and stale-Box cases; save actual screenshots/receipts.

Independent compare human/agent API bindings, wrong token, stale context, cancellation and output bounds.
